claims.quoted_text: So, let's assume all 10 cats with black fur catch mice, then the number of cats that do not catch mice and have black fur will be 0.
claims.explanation: This assumption is impossible: only 7 cats catch mice in total, so at most 7 of the 10 black cats can catch mice. Therefore at least 10 - 7 = 3 black cats must be among the 17 cats that do not catch mice. Inclusion-exclusion gives the minimum as 17 + 10 - 24 = 3, not 0.
